NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 3:34 PM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 23.8 DraftKings points for $7,700, at Minnesota. Christian McCaffrey (18.3, $8,600) and Jonathan Taylor (18.2, $6,900) are next.

Bijan Robinson is also the top value at the position: 3.09 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 3:34 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 12

Bijan Robinson, ATL at MIN ($7,700)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.8 DraftKings points at $7,700, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.5 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 20.2 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 3.09 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 16 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Robinson averaged 23.8 points with a simulated floor of 11.4 and a ceiling of 42.0, and he holds 0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 7-point underdog on the road against Minnesota, with an implied team total of 17.75 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF vs SEA ($8,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 18.3 DraftKings points at $8,600. The model gives him 12.9 carries and 4.7 targets. The salary works out to 2.13 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 16 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 18.3 points with a simulated floor of 8.0 and a ceiling of 33.3, and he holds 13% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3-point favorite at home against Seattle, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Jonathan Taylor, IND vs NYG ($6,900)

Jonathan Taylor projects 3rd at the position with 18.2 DraftKings points at $6,900. The model gives him 15.0 carries and 5.4 targets. The salary works out to 2.64 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 16 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Taylor averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 33.4, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Indianapolis is a 6.5-point underdog at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 17.5 in a game totaled at 41.5.

Value: David Montgomery, HOU vs BAL ($5,700)

David Montgomery projects for 13.6 DraftKings points at $5,700, which works out to 2.38 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 16 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 16.7 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 50,000 simulations Montgomery averaged 13.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 30.4, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 6.5-point favorite at home against Baltimore, with an implied team total of 27 in a game totaled at 47.5.
